name: 76706 · Waco, TX
findings: ZIP 76706 (Waco) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76706 (Waco) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 76706 (Waco) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).
